We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

schemaMarkup.reviewBody: This was my first time going to Riccobene Associates Family Dentistry. It was super clean, and everyone was super friendly! I loved my dental hygienist; she is fantastic! The dentist was very kind and very professional! If you're looking for the best dentist, please don't look any further! You’re in the right place!

The practice is great… The workers in there are great, you know, everybody is so nice and so helpful. I love it there, and I love the way the DENTIST talks to you while he’s doing what he’s doing because it helps to let you know what’s going on.

This was my family's and my first visit to this office. We will definitely be making this office our home office. The entire staff was amazing. Very helpful, friendly, knowledgeable, and straight to the point about what services we needed and didn’t overwhelm us with a lot of unnecessary services that my prior dentist's office listed for us.

My mother, my daughter, and I go here for all of our dental needs. My daughter has major anxiety, and going to the dentist is a challenge. She does well with cleaning and exams. But she recently had to get cavities filled. Her anxiety got the best of her, and she had to reschedule her visit. Today, we went, and the ENTIRE staff that we interacted with was amazing. They were patient with her, they were caring, and they answered all of her questions. She got in and out in under an hour. They took their time and made her feel so comfortable and at ease. This will forever be our dental home!

Today was my first visit to this dentist. It was a wonderful experience. I get very anxious when I go to the dentist but the staff there made me feel comfortable. The dentist and dental hygienist were both very gentle. The office was very clean. Staff were very friendly and professional. They explained everything before doing it, which was very important to me, and it helped me to feel more relaxed.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What services are offered at the Oxford, NC, dental office?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

How do I book an appointment with your Oxford, NC dentists?

To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!

Does the Oxford, NC, office provide pediatric dental care?

Absolutely. We recognize the importance of starting dental care as early as possible and make sure to provide kids and families with pediatric dental care comfortably and comprehensively, as they deserve.

Is emergency dental care available in Oxford, NC?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Can I get dental implants at the Oxford, NC, office?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including dental implants.

What cosmetic options are available in Oxford, NC?

We understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Where is your Oxford, NC, office located, and what are its hours?

Our office Hours are Monday-Thursday: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM, Friday: 8:00 AM – 1:00 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday. Our office is located at 2702 Medical Office Place, 111 East Industry Dr., Oxford, NC 27564. We look forward to seeing you!

Do you accept insurance or offer membership plans in Oxford, NC?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

What sedation or comfort options are offered for anxious patients?

We offer a variety of sedation dentistry options. You can choose from Nitrous Oxide, IV Sedation, and Local Anesthesia for your comfort.
